QUOTE: "transfer accuracy of 0.87" METRIC: transfer_acc ISSUE: Transfer accuracy is 0.84; 0.87 is the strong-model ceiling (strong_acc).
QUOTE: "this is a gain well outside the standard error" METRIC: baseline_pgr ISSUE: No standard error is reported for the baseline PGR, so the significance of the difference cannot be established from the given data.
